Source.Description: Community squeezebox controller 3rd party VU image.
Source.Further-Modifications: cropping, transparent surround, and needle modification by blaisedias https://github.com/blaisedias

#volume_levels: 0 counts as a volume level, so when volume_levels=50 the max volume level is 49
#dimensions: unscaled width and height of the vumeter
width  = left_margin + dial_width + spacing + dial_width + right_margin
#files: The set of images required to render this VU-Meter
#rotaries: rotaries is an associative array of rotary definitions
a rotary defines image rotation parameters
Fields of a rotary are:
resource: image identifier
enclosure: { w:width, h:height}
axle: { x:x-coordinate, y:y-coordinate} # with the enclosure
bearing: { x:x-coordinate, y:y-coordinate, w:width, h:height}
enclosure defines a rectangle in which the rotation occurs,
and should have the same dimensions as layout left and/or right rectangle.
typically layout left and right have identical dimensions, if they do not
different rotaries are required for left and right
axle defines the point relative to the enclosure around which rotation occurs
bearing defines
- the dimensions at which the resource image is rendered
- the point around which the rendered resource image is rotated
the bearing is overlaid on to the enclosure such that the bearing location (x,y) is exactly on top of the axle
For analog vu meters:
enclosure defines the dimensions of the dial
axle defines where the needle rotates around in the dial
bearing defines where the needle is affixed to the axle
#placement: placement is an associative array of image aliases to coordinates
each placement specifies where an image associated with an alias will be rendered
#compositions*: associative array with keys
The contents of each key must be objects which are associative arrays with keys
'render_op' : one of 'single', 'aggregate', 'aggregate-off'
'static' => all placements are rendered regardless of volume_type anf volume level
rendering is fixed (static) as opposed to dynamic (changes with audio volume level)
'single' => only render the placement matching the volume level
'aggregate' => render all placements upto the volume level
'aggregate-off' => render all placements beyond the volume level
'volume_type' : one of
'sampled': volume levels are rendered to match sampled values
'peak-hold+sampled'  : peak volume level is held for a brief time and rendered in non-aggregated manner,
lower volume levels are rendered to match sampled values
'decay' : (default) volume levels follows peak volume level decaying at configured rate, if lower
'peak-hold+decay' : peak volume level is held for a brief time and rendered in non-aggregated manner,
lower volume levels follows peak volume level decaying at configured rate
Notes:
1) decay is for use with VU Meters simulating analog VU Meters with needles
2) hold is for use with digital VU Meters, where multiple volume levels can be rendered in a frame
3) if peak is not set then volume levels are rendered to match sampled values
'placements': an associative arrays of volume level to placements
'render_op' and 'placements' are REQUIRED
volume_type is optional:
- defaults to 'sampled'
- is ignored when the value 'render_op' is 'static'
Notes:  Each non static object does not have to contain placement references for each volume level
However the combination of objects SHOULD contain placement references for each volume level
